exposure: Temporary bilateral laparoscopic uterine artery clipping with hysteroscopic transcervical resection (LUA clipping-TCR)
cohort: The study included nine patients diagnosed with cervical pregnancies, identified from a total of 164 ectopic pregnancies.
finding: LUA clipping-TCR is an effective minimally invasive treatment for cervical pregnancy management and fertility preservation.
followup_time: Up to live birth for some patients, with short-term outcomes such as resumption of menstruation observed between 35-80 days post-procedure.
